question: Can one global prefix-free consonant/vowel code, latent unit boundaries, explicit Latin paradigm forms and sentence-feature templates jointly identify complete plaintext?
scope: New orthographic abugida model; not a claim of Latin language, phonetic values or medieval script ancestry.

channel.plaintext: lowercase Latin a-z; Unicode combining quantity marks removed, ae/oe ligatures expanded; u/v and i/j retained as written
channel.inherent_vowel: one globally selected member of aeiouy; all six possibilities retained
channel.scan: left-to-right, greedily consume a consonant and immediately following vowel as CV; otherwise consume one C or V
channel.CV: C:<letter>, followed by V:<vowel> iff vowel differs from inherent
channel.V: CARRIER, followed by V:<vowel> iff vowel differs from inherent
channel.code: one global injective prefix-free assignment from the 20 consonant bases, five noninherent vowel modifiers, CARRIER and VIRAMA to nonempty ciphertext strings of length 1 or 2
channel.word_boundary: one complete written group equals one complete plaintext word; no cross-space codes
channel.exceptions: none; no nulls, lexical root codes, per-word substitutions or position-dependent keys
channel.unobserved_rules: No identification credit; output equivalence, not unused parameter equality, determines recovery.

lexicon.paradigms: LatInfLexi commit60c6f115a354abc3ad24456a5bbba7f3b7cae8fc orth_form + cell + lexeme, retaining all analyses and defective/missing distinctions
lexicon.limitations: Classical/pre-/post-Classical noun/verb lemma sample; medieval-specific lexemes and adjective/pronoun/function paradigms absent
lexicon.supplement: all exact attested alphabetic forms and complete analyses from the fixed GDT832 ITTB-TRAIN source; no target-selected additions
lexicon.sentence_grammar: Fixed feature/dependency CFG induced from projective complete ITTB-TRAIN sentence trees: each production preserves the ordered immediate dependents, head position and projected grammatical features. All rules are source-derived; no target rules. A paragraph may concatenate complete source-rooted parses. Restricted grammar, not all Latin syntax.
lexicon.identification: Complete noun/verb paradigms constrain source forms and features; one letter channel binds stems and endings. Feature-isomorphic free lexeme permutations are not separate allowed key operations.

control.source: unchanged GDT832 UDante-TRAIN source, independent from ITTB reference
control.selection: first12 source-order complete non-MWT sentences of6..16 alphabetic lexical tokens entirely covered by frozen source lexicon AND admitted by frozen reference grammar; punctuation excluded as punctuation only, no lexical omissions. Then next12 eligible sentences whose used component set is contained in discovery for EACH of the six possible inherent vowels; reject a whole sentence, never individual words.
control.key: independent generator seed commitment;12 single-character codewords and15 two-character codewords with first characters from the remaining8 alphabet symbols; random injective permutation over27 components; one inherent vowel hidden
control.source_words: no deletion, reordering, case-targeted repair or injected examples
control.exposure: root sees ciphertext only until fit candidates and completeness status are locked; source selector and generator are independent
control.recovery: all discovery and held words exact under every surviving plaintext projection, every observed rule recovered up to equivalent parameterizations; a timeout is UNKNOWN_BUDGET, not unique or rejected
control.coverage: Every held-used component is observed in discovery, checked for all6 inherent vowels before key selection. No exact-identity requirement for unused key rules.

budget.interpretation: Includes preparation, implementation, independent validation and publication; reassess before expansion. No automatic failed-control repairs.

target: No Voynich fit selected by this preregistration. A passing control and explicit manuscript contract are needed; existing f84/f84r seals and179-selector limit remain.
risk: The observed manuscript may violate this finite channel; source incompleteness, search incompleteness, model failure and unidentified meanings remain distinct.
